title: Lanternway - Long Lane Home
_note: The signature travel loop dialled to 'lanterns coming on at dusk' - cosier, a shade melancholy, the walk back. gbc 4-voice band. 112 BPM, 4/4, warm G major with a gentle vi (em) lean. 32-bar AABA. Vesper motif BOUNCING form relaxed into a strolling sway: the hop (D4->G4->A4 lift) softened to legato quarters, the settle-home (B4->A4->G4) savoured. lead=same hook but softer/more legato, wistful evening colour. harmony=arps slower and rounder, fewer sparkle notes. bass=walking but relaxed, quarter-note feel. drums=lighter brushed feel, no fills. Last bar D(V) -> resolves to G bar 1.

tracks.name: lead
tracks._note: Softer legato strolling version. A (1-8), A (9-16), B with vi/em lean (17-24), A home (25-32).
